1.body:
Hello,

I saw your UI/UX Designer opening at Violet Info and wanted to connect, especially since you are building digital experiences that require both wireframing and structured design systems.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability, while also building visual identity systems.

You can see this process in my Bounceless case study, a B2B UX project demonstrating a cleaner verification experience for teams, available at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am based in Nagpur and ready to relocate to Mumbai for this role. Could we take 15 minutes next week to review one of these user flows together?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
